side_a: CC 3.2: The receiver checks, in this order and before any cryptography: a per-sender-key rate, a per-link rate, then a node-wide ceiling on pending requests

note: One receiver gate, stated as an ordered sequence for a device-join request and as "a set and not a sequence" for the route request; CC 5.4.6 calls it "the receiver order of the first-contact plane". note: Rule 1 and the lead of CC 4.5.4 read as "no moderator, no federation"; rule 2 and CC 4.5.13 keep the room readable and carry its ballots between nodes until one is seated, and only rule 3 stops it. A reader of rule 1 alone refuses the ballots the election needs.

side_b: CC 4.5.13: **A steward, where one exists, MAY appoint a moderator directly at any point and end the vote.**
note: Nobody may act in a locked room, yet members sign ballots, withdrawals, an acceptance and a resignation, and a steward appoints. The lock is on posts, admissions and moderation; the sentence says more.
